_about: House hypotheses to test with MYMU evidence. No universal performance multipliers or ranking guarantees. Existing historical research remains background, not a measured MYMU result.
formula: Specific subject + visible stakes + proof marker + one honest open loop, inside the surface's first readable space, with the words people search for early, and the payoff delivered fast.
everywhere: Name the subject and a specific stake. Deliver the promised finding early.
Use first-person experience only when the published source establishes Krish actually did it.
Use a number or quote only with a literal cited source.
Choose one useful next step matched to reader intent.
Use plain British English, no em dashes, percentages, stock phrases or invented results.
A claim about what works needs dated MYMU observations and comparable windows.

linkedin.formula: Name the topic early, show a specific stake and a useful finding. First-person experience must be in the source. Preview the fold on the actual device.

article.formula: Respect the published piece. Suggest a clear topic and truthful benefit as a conversion fix; do not rewrite the editorial pipeline. Preview subject and subtitle on mobile.

blog.formula: Use a clear, unique title and accurate description that match search intent and the visible page. Google may rewrite or truncate either; character counts are drafting aids, not ranking rules. Offer original evidence only when the published piece contains it.

shorts.formula: Name the topic and a specific supported outcome. Make the first frame legible, caption the spoken hook and deliver the promise. Native continuation first; no promise of a clickable description link.

youtube.formula: Use a specific subject and supported stake. Make the title and thumbnail add information to one another; avoid clickbait or invented experience.
youtube.links: Links in Shorts descriptions and comments are not clickable: say and show the name; link the related long video; put the tracked link first in the long description and the pinned comment.

x.formula: Thread: counterintuitive hook, stakes for a named reader, evidence, framework, application, open loop, a specific subscribe line. Post 1 stands alone.
x.cadence: Budget-led selection across all jobs. Drafting quotas never override the daily work limit.

instagram.formula: Win the first three seconds. Reels for reach, carousels for saves, Stories for conversion (tension, insight, proof, link sticker), Collabs for shared reach.

tiktok.formula: Lead with tension, result or surprise at once; every clip stands alone; captions and on-screen keywords; numbered series; reply to strong comments with video; close with one specific continuation that names makeyourmindup.

spotify.formula: Predictable cadence, value before the ask, one spoken ask at the end, the matched link in show notes, one 9:16 clip under 90 seconds per episode, mark the best place to start.

cta_ladder.cold: save it, watch part two, read the free breakdown
cta_ladder.curious: get the full finding or source list
